ev.q: Seven of the eight patients were hospitalized, none developed severe malaria
During June 19–July 17, 2023, six additional cases of autochthonous P. vivax malaria were reported to CDC by FDOH.
Thrombocytopenia was reported for all eight patients, and six were anemic.
